_note: QA ticket 7 (docs/reviews/QA_LIVE_2026-10-20.md, grammar and typos). Suggest mode: content review desk, no direct save. Fourteen visible jutsu and items get minimal text corrections built by exact substring replacement on the public read of 2026-10-20T19:37:17.859Z (each replaced substring occurs once); approved by dauntless 2026-10-20. Item battle lines are only touched on items usable in combat. Jutsu re-send injectableInBattle at its live value (law 20). Violet Stormglass (description copied from a tusk) and his/her battle lines are deliberately excluded. Operator runs it from Forge; never skipPreflight.
